heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 114–95, title IV, § 4001(b)(3)(D)(ii), Dec. 10, 2015, 129 Stat. 1967

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 89–10, title IV, § 5308, formerly title V, § 5308, as added Pub. L. 107–110, title V, § 501, Jan. 8, 2002, 115 Stat. 1810; renumbered title IV, § 5308, Pub. L. 114–95, title IV, § 4001(b)(3)(A), (B), Dec. 10, 2015, 129 Stat. 1967, prohibited certain uses of grants under this part.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 5308 of Pub. L. 89–10 was classified to section 7268 of this title, prior to the general amendment of former subchapter V of this chapter by Pub. L. 107–110.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Dec. 10, 2015, except with respect to certain noncompetitive programs and competitive programs, see section 5 of Pub. L. 114–95, set out as an Effective Date of 2015 Amendment note under section 6301 of this title.

ancestors.heading: STRENGTHENING AND IMPROVEMENT OF ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS
